turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
cord tied, no pulling at shoulders or crotch

First wash • Turn pieces inside out • Tie waist cords • Wash in cold water with similar colors • Tumble dry low heat (or hang dry) so fabric and color last

Week-one tips • Load your usual gear in the pockets and walk around • If anything feels too tight when you move, note what you’d size up or down in next time

If you tell me your height, weight and usual tee size, I can sanity-check the Leon + Tansen size you’re thinking about.
